traced_fixed_sample.next: A product repair needs a low-perturbation method that can reproduce and localize the untraced excess; this sample supports no speculative optimization.

launch_order_context.definition: Repeat/switch refers only to the preceding selected guard image within these captured slots; it is not a measured cache state. The first slot prior context is outside each capture.
launch_order_context.finding: Each image appears ten times first and ten times second, but after the first pair first position always repeats the previous selected image and second always switches. Position and immediate repeat context cannot be separated in these records.
launch_order_context.estimand_limits: Recorded paired medians remain descriptions of this fixed schedule. Missing image-by-position-by-prior-context cells prevent testing image-specific carryover and time interactions, so the schedule does not isolate intrinsic or cold/warm image speed.
launch_order_context.additive_model_note: Under an assumed stable additive model with common position and repeat effects for both images, balanced CR/RC pair orders cancel those terms in the arithmetic mean apart from the initial slot. The missing cells do not test that assumption; medians have no corresponding cancellation guarantee.
launch_order_context.cause: No cache, antivirus, scheduler or other carryover mechanism is established.

post_endpoint_cpu_method.subject: Original selected guard process only, summed across its own threads; excludes the payload.
post_endpoint_cpu_method.probe_order: Byte-exact original payload observer and first raw retained-payload poll complete after the elapsed endpoint; then GetProcessTimes and QueryProcessCycleTime use the original retained CreateProcess handle before cleanup.
post_endpoint_cpu_method.limits: Whole-guard CPU-work correlate only. CPU time units do not establish measurement precision; raw cycles cannot be converted to elapsed time or attributed to a phase. CPU-query failure remains inconclusive, separate from the original custody verdict. The post-endpoint probe may affect later-slot context.
